parsed.explanation: No documented trans-specific criminalisation, entry, facility-ban or police-targeting regime, and national penal protections apply. The operative visitor exposure is custody: trans women are placed by legal marker in practice in all-male facilities facing assault threats, and the detention watchdog in 2021 found persistence of serious violations across all deprivation-of-liberty sites after some 40 referrals since 2010, with no documented remedy or local inspection. That is an unremedied tier-1 custodial placement exposure, contingent on detention but severe if it occurs, placing the combined regime in Elevated Risk. Resident-facing recognition, marriage and discrimination law are climate signals only and do not offset it. Custody status after 2021 is uncertain, not safety.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Custody placement by legal gender marker, in practice all-male facilities for trans women facing detainee assault threats; watchdog 2021 found persistence of serious violations across all places of deprivation of liberty, some 40 referrals since 2010.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. Watchdog findings are corroboration of unremedied practice, not a working remedy.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any arrest, immigration or other detention would route the visitor into this marker-based placement; no documented individual-assessment alternative.

federal_state_facilities.interaction: No local ordinance narrowing national framework is documented; absence is not evidence of a facility regime.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors. Resident care-access inequities and a stalled 2024 minor-transition bill are not traveller-facing exposures on this record.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-specific presentation offence or organised targeting documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Penal-code discrimination ground since 2012, wording updated to gender identity 2016; transphobic motive aggravating factor since 2017 for crimes punishable by imprisonment. Climate/recourse signal, not an offset to custody placement.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Protections address private discrimination/assault outside custody and do not change documented custody placement.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented for travelling minors with guardians.
minors_guardians.interaction: A May 2024 senate bill to ban medical transition under 18 had no documented update after 23 July 2024 and is opposed by government; status uncertain and resident-care focused, not a documented visitor travel restriction.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Police recorded around 1,870 combined homophobic and transphobic victims nationally in 2019, up from 1,380 in 2018. No trans-only breakdown, denominator, collectivity-specific data or current rate; not usable as a trans-specific prevalence measure.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Transphobic aggravating factor since 2017 is a documented legal recourse signal; outcomes for trans visitors not documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Street response does not remedy documented custodial violations.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No post-2021 follow-up, local-establishment inspection, or remedy for custodial violations documented; local incidence of the 2018 pattern not sourced.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty is treated as unresolved, not as evidence the 2021 violations have ceased.

anchor_checks.comparison: Closest anchor: binding custodial placement with documented humiliation/harassment, oversight recommendations without effective change, no presentation offence, and services otherwise served. This case matches that structure, with 2021 serious-violations persistence instead of recent inspections, hence a similar score.

Lower than this case: 0.35-B combines hospital and detention birth-sex placement with repeated harassment and failed inspectors complaints. Here only custody is documented, with no hospital-ward, bathroom or police-extortion layer, so materially above 0.35.

Lower than this case: 0.55-A has recurring service refusals and slow remedies but no unremedied universal custodial placement. The documented serious custodial violations without a working remedy push this case below the 0.55 tier.

Well below: 0.65-A has accepted documents, no facility exclusion, corrected refusals, convictions for attackers and only limited custody-monitoring uncertainty. Here custody placement and serious violations are documented, not merely unmonitored.

parsed.synthesis: The combined national regime leaves a traveller without a documented trans-specific ban on entry, presence, facilities or care, and provides a penal discrimination/aggravation framework, but those protections do not alter custody. If a visitor is detained, marker-based placement in all-male facilities with documented assault threats and a 2021 watchdog finding of persistent serious violations across all sites, unremedied on this record, is the governing exposure. Oversight without documented correction is corroboration, not recourse. No local variation is documented. The result is Elevated Risk around the 0.45 anchor, contingent on detention yet severe when it occurs.
